description: This file defines the CalendarAccountController class for managing calendar accounts within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes actions for editing, saving, testing connections, retrieving provider authentication methods, and triggering manual synchronization. The class interacts with CalendarAccount beans and external CalendarSync utilities, handles exceptions uniformly, and provides JSON responses for API endpoints.

classes.name: CalendarAccountController
classes.description: Controller class for handling calendar account operations such as editing, saving, testing connection, and synchronization within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_EditView
methods.description: Handles the display of the edit view for a calendar account; sets default type if not provided.

methods.name: action_save
methods.description: Saves the calendar account data, handling exceptions and redirection upon failure.

methods.name: action_getProviderAuthMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication method for a specified calendar provider and returns it as JSON.

methods.name: action_testConnection
methods.description: Performs a test connection to the calendar provider, returning detailed results including success status, duplicate account info, and error messages.

methods.name: action_syncCalendarAccount
methods.description: Triggers manual synchronization of a specified calendar account and responds with confirmation.

methods.name: setupCalendarAccountFromRequest
methods.description: Initializes and populates a CalendarAccount object from request parameters, including OAuth, username/password, and API key settings.

methods.name: handleApiException
methods.description: Provides standardized handling of exceptions, mapping them to HTTP status codes and error responses.

methods.name: sendJsonResponse
methods.description: Outputs a JSON response with proper headers and status, handling encoding errors gracefully.
